# TABLES  (generated by scripts/build.py)
# Entry rule: first trace row with tau <= 120 (the engine's "120 s left" row is tau=119.25), state LOCKED or PROVEN LOCKED,
#   and the rule's pf condition. R_disp: pf < 0.0025; R_exact: pf <= 0.002. won = entry side == truth. E = sum of pf at entry.
# Bins: tau "120" = entry at the first scanned row (tau=119.25, window already locked when the final 120 s begin);
#   cushion = feed-only side-signed cushion in bps of strike (gap if UP else -gap; mu NOT included);
#   dc20 = entry cushion minus cushion 20 s earlier (bps), n/a when the trace has no row 20 s before entry (entry tau > 104.25);
#   sig quintile cuts (from de-duplicated R_disp entries): 0.2564, 0.3708, 0.5040, 0.7260;
#   mu = basis estimate (USD) as carried in the trace (engine locks on sign(gap + mu)); secs since first LOCKED uses the
#   window-level firstLocked.tau from the .ndjson (may precede the 125-s trace).
# Loss classes (task definition): reversal = lost and feed-only signed cushion < 0 at some row after entry; basis = lost, never < 0.
#   NOTE: an entry whose feed-only cushion is already <= 0 at entry (lock carried by mu) counts as "reversal" under this strict
#   definition even though the feed never crossed after entry; the refined classification below separates these.
# 95% CI = Clopper-Pearson exact binomial interval for the loss rate.

De-duplicated set: 28541 markets (28541 taken from usdc, 0 from usdt). usdc family: 28541 windows; usdt family: 28541 windows.
Every ticker is present in both families, so the de-duplicated set is identical to the usdc family; the usdt tables are the
same markets seen through the BTC/USDT feed (a robustness check, NOT an independent sample).
